lines: +The old proxy assumed a conversation only ever appends tokens: it rendered the first prompt, then glued on individually rendered new messages plus its own previous output. That breaks whenever history is rewritten (Terminus summarization/unwinding, interleaved-reasoning changes) or the chat template is not prefix-stable (the GLM agent template drops old reasoning and truncates old user turns), so prompts diverged from SGLang's chat rendering and inflated until they hit the context limit. It now re-renders every request in full, with SGLang 0.5.9's chat preprocessing (content parts, `None` content, tool/tool-choice normalization, tool-call argument object conversion, last-assistant/`continue_final_message` handling, per-request template kwargs, and generation-config sampling defaults/stop handling).

+Training rows are now built per agent session as segments: a generation chains into the open sample only when the next prompt really starts with the previous prompt plus the sampled ids (re-tokenized prefixes are spliced back to the engine's own ids where the rendered text matches an earlier prompt/generation of that agent); otherwise it starts a new sample with that exact prompt. Sessions are keyed by `X-Session-ID`/`session_id` (falling back to the URL id), grouped under the episode URL, so explorers get their own rows and episode `finish` returns everyone's.

+Aborted engine generations are returned as 5xx instead of partial "stop" answers and are never committed; a client disconnect aborts the engine request (`rid` + `/abort_request`) and commits nothing; an identical retry (the only sign a gateway-dropped response never reached the agent) rolls back the previous tentative generation before generating afresh. Reasoning/tool output parsing was aligned with SGLang's detectors (incl. tool parsing only when tools are supplied, schema-typed GLM arguments, and Qwen/Hermes JSON tool calls).

+Verification: new unit/HTTP tests in `terminal_rl/tests/test_proxy.py` pass; parser output now matches all recorded SGLang responses. Full replays (fake engine, `--abort-rate 0.05`): GLM 1618/1618 engine prompt texts and ids match SGLang rendering, 1412 trained runs all match a delivered non-abort engine generation, 0 aborted tokens trained; Qwen 646/646 prompt texts match (92 prompts intentionally keep sampled ids over a re-tokenization), 409 trained runs all matched; `check_samples.py` reports 0 mismatches on both. The kept live Qwen run `20261027-051645` completed: 8 episodes x 3 agents, 233 agent requests (213 answered 200), 28 gateway-dropped responses, 8 gateway give-ups, 231 engine generations with 10 aborted across 4 weight updates, and 44 rows from `finish`.
